description: STF-GGRU Reproducibility Dataset for Traffic Flow Prediction (PeMSD4 & PeMSD8) is a data set deposited in Figshare by its authors karimeh Atta, Sameer Alani. This dataset supports the reproducibility of the paper:"Integrated Spatiotemporal Feature Alignment with Graph Convolutional and Gated Recurrent Networks for Traffic Flow Prediction"It includes:- PeMSD4 dataset - PeMSD8 dataset Dataset structure:- PEMS04/: contains traffic data and distance matrix- PEMS08/: contains traffic data and distance matrix Each folder includes:- .npz file for traffic data- distance.csv file for ... Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. Size stated: 50886311 Bytes. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-figshare-repository.
